title: Our Ethics and Compliance Programme
text: Back to Ethics and compliance GlencoreSustainability ...Ethics and complianceOur Ethics and Compliance ProgrammeOur Ethics and Compliance ProgrammeShareOur Ethics and Compliance Programme includes various elements related to risk assessments, policies, standards, procedures and guidelines, training and awareness, advice, monitoring, speaking openly and raising concerns, investigations, and discipline and incentives.ShareThe Glencore Ethics and Compliance ProgrammeKey elements of our programmeOur Ethics and Compliance Programme includes various elements related to risk assessments, policies, standards, procedures and guidelines, training and awareness, advice, monitoring, speaking openly and raising concerns, investigations, and discipline and incentives.Dedicated compliance IT systems and data analytics as well as various controls embedded in business systems support our Ethics and Compliance Programme.The key elements of our Ethics and Compliance Programme establish a risk-based approach to ethics and compliance to address the challenges presented by our diverse business operations. Together, the elements create a feedback loop, designed to ensure that compliance risks are identified and addressed across our business on an ongoing basis.Our Ethics and Compliance Programme has been designed with the support of external counsel and other advisors, having regard to the guidance from relevant authorities such as the US Department of Justice, the UK Ministry of Justice and the State Secretariat for Economic Affairs of Switzerland.Identifying, assessing and evaluating compliance risks and controlsView moreEstablishing approaches and requirements to mitigate compliance risks and reflect ethical and legal expectations and requirements. View moreTraining and raising awareness on ethics and compliance risks. View moreProviding advice and guidance to employees on ethics and compliance matters. View moreAssessing the effectiveness of the  Ethics and Compliance Programme implementation and identifying opportunities for improvement. View moreProviding safe channels to raise concerns regarding potential misconduct, including via our Raising Concerns Programme. View moreCoordinating objective and consistent internal investigations, whilst maintaining confidentiality and protecting against retaliationView moreEnsuring an appropriate system for discipline and incentives. View moreOur Ethics and Compliance Programme in actionDeal lifecycle trainingView moreAutomation of vessel screeningView moreLaunch of Social Contribution FrameworkView moreSpeaking openly and refreshed Code of Conduct townhallView moreImportant notice This material does not purport to contain all of the information you may wish to consider.
